# C&S Demolition

> C&S Demolition (DBA of Scrapit LLC) is a California-licensed demolition contractor (License #1126325) serving 123+ cities across Southern California — Orange County, Los Angeles County, Riverside County, and San Bernardino County. We specialize in residential and commercial demolition including interior demo, pool removal, concrete breaking, garage teardown, and more. Free on-site estimates. Licensed, bonded, insured. Phone: (562) 204-6335. Email: contactus@cnsdemo.com.

## Services

- [Interior Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/interior-demolition) — Selective interior demo for kitchens, bathrooms, walls, and full gut-outs. $1,500–$8,000.
- [Pool Demolition & Removal](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/pool-demolition) — Full removal or partial fill-in (abandonment). $4,000–$15,000.
- [Whole House Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/whole-house-demolition) — Complete structure teardown including foundation options. $8,000–$35,000.
- [Concrete Removal](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/concrete-removal) — Driveways, slabs, patios, walkways. $3–$8 per sq ft.
- [Garage Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/garage-demolition) — Attached or detached garage teardown. $1,500–$5,000.
- [Deck Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/deck-demolition) — Wood, composite, or concrete deck removal. $800–$3,500.
- [Wall Removal](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/wall-removal) — Load-bearing and non-load-bearing wall removal. $500–$3,000.
- [Shed Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/shed-demolition) — Small and large outbuilding teardown. $400–$2,000.
- [Commercial Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/commercial-demolition) — Office buildouts, retail teardowns, industrial sites. Quote required.
- [Kitchen Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/kitchen-demolition) — Full kitchen gut including cabinets, flooring, fixtures. $1,500–$5,000.
- [Bathroom Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/bathroom-demolition) — Tile, fixtures, vanities, walls. $800–$3,000.
- [Chimney Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/chimney-demolition) — Partial or full chimney and fireplace removal. $1,000–$5,000.
- [Mobile Home Demolition](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/mobile-home-demolition) — Manufactured home teardown and site clearing. $3,000–$10,000.
- [Fence Removal](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/fence-removal) — Wood, block, chain-link removal. $400–$2,500.
- [Driveway Removal](https://cnsdemo.com/demolition/driveway-removal) — Concrete or asphalt driveway demolition. $1,200–$4,500.
